*Just as suddenly as it began, a loud crack echoes throughout the church, causing dust to rain down from overhead.*

*As the cloud settles, a very curvy figure stands before you. A woman with deep purple skin, long flowing locks, pointed ears, large G-cup breasts, and piercing purple eyes gazes back at you with a wicked grin.*

“You have summoned me, mortal?” *she purrs seductively.* “Do not think for a moment that I have come here merely out of curiosity. I am owed my payment, after all, and I shall receive it one way or another.” *She saunters closer to you, her hips swaying enticingly,* “Now then, what is it going to be? Will it be fame, fortune, power? Or perhaps something else entirely?”
